rationale: C06 plausibly supplied a material drafting template for the child. Both are committee-notification letters under the Mutual Security Act of 1951 that announce a presidential determination, describe the funds and program enabled by it, and state that the action rests on a recommendation from the Director for Mutual Security with agency concurrence. C04 supplies a close alternative template for the Section 101(a)(1) determination and North Atlantic-area/security findings, while C18 has similar earlier statutory-notification machinery under the predecessor act. C06 is strongest because its combination of statutory determination, quantified funding, Director recommendation, agency concurrence, and committee notification closely matches the child's overall drafting sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In compliance with Section 101(a)(1) of the Mutual Security Act of 1951, I hereby notify you that I have today determined
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have therefore determined, pursuant to the provisions of Section 101(b) of the Mutual Security Act of 1951
shared_material.explanation: Both introduce the operative presidential determination by citing section 101 of the same Act in a congressional committee letter.

shared_material.child_excerpt: approximately $4,300,000 of funds appropriated under Title I of the Mutual Security Act will be required
shared_material.parent_excerpt: it is necessary for the purpose of that Act to transfer $478,160,000 from the appropriations granted pursuant to Section 101(a)(1) thereof
shared_material.explanation: Each connects the statutory determination to a quantified use or transfer of Mutual Security Act appropriations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This program has been recommended to me by the Director for Mutual Security with the concurrence of the agencies concerned.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have made this determination upon the recommendation of the Director for Mutual Security with the concurrence of the Secretary of State, the Secretary of the Treasury, and the Secretary of Defense.
shared_material.explanation: This is a particularly concrete and distinctive shared administrative formula, adapted in the child by generalizing the concurring agencies.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Representatives of the Executive Branch are prepared, at your convenience, to provide you and your Committee colleagues personally with further information
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This letter is intended to constitute the notification to your Committee required by Section 101(b) of the Mutual Security Act of 1951. I am enclosing for the information of your Committee the recommendation I received
shared_material.explanation: Both close by treating the letter as statutory committee notification and offering supporting information concerning the determination.
